newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Four more die from eating deadly fungi in Romania.
newsitem.headline: Four more die from eating deadly fungi in Romania.

text.p: Four more people, including two children, have died in central Romania after eating poisonous mushrooms, the state Rompres news agency said on Friday.
Poisonings occur regularly in post-Communist Romania, where hard-pressed consumers view mushrooms as a cheap way to feed their families or a chance to make easy money selling them at markets.
But some varieties of mushrooms are poisonous and recent rains have caused the deadly fungi to flourish.
The latest casualties, who died in hospital in the city of Tirgu Mures in the central region of Transylvania, bring the death toll to at least 13 this year, the agency said.
In Baia Mare, near the border with Ukraine after 62 people, most of them children, were taken to hospital last month after eating poisonous mushrooms. Nine died
Health authorities launched a television campaign telling consumers and sellers how to identify poisonous fungi. A ban has also been imposed on unauthorised picking and sales.
